$comment: Machine-readable source declarations. Runtime enforcement is source-sweep's preflight (SKILL.md Step 2): connector registration and session tool availability are different surfaces, so every run probes by tool search, and probes the fetch constraint too, since it is environment-conditional (claude.ai fetch only accepts search-surfaced URLs; Claude Code fetches EDGAR and registry API URLs directly). 'required' = the skill's core promise breaks without it (run is partial and must say so); 'preferred' = degrades acceptably via the protocols in source-sweep. Kept out of plugin.json because the manifest schema rejects custom root keys.

biocentury.degradedFallback: none — editorial-pass coverage may not be claimed without it; every narrative/expectations claim becomes a named gap

clinicaltrials.degradedFallback: Claude Code: direct ClinicalTrials.gov API fetch (full querying, primary tier); claude.ai: search-mediated, recall incomplete

pubmed.degradedFallback: search-mediated via PubMed/publisher result pages; corporate-affiliation queries not replicable

sec.connector: Beat and Raise or EDGAR direct
sec.degradedFallback: EDGAR direct (efts.sec.gov full-text search + filing index) is first-class in Claude Code, not a degraded mode; claude.ai without the connector: search-mediated

daloopa.degradedFallback: optional; financial fundamentals fall back to SEC filings

web.degradedFallback: n/a — web search is itself the degraded path for other sources

source-sweep.note: requirements are archetype-dependent; see SKILL.md Steps 1-3

competitor-discovery.note: without the registry pass the set may not be described as complete; without BioCentury the editorial pass is a named gap

catalyst-timeline.note: registry drives ESTIMATED derivations; without BioCentury the expectations cross-check is marked absent where it would have applied

scenario-planning.note: consumes upstream hand-offs; uses source-sweep for claim substantiation

landscape-report.note: union of the chain; a required-source failure is a stage-failure event, not a quiet degrade

client-profile.note: filesystem only — reads the client folder

client-onboard.note: public clients need the filings pass; private clients drop 'sec' and mark the asymmetry

client-deliverable.note: formatting only — consumes checkpoint-passed content and the template
